title: Batch database work outside loops
why: Issuing a database operation for each loop item creates N+1 latency and load that grows linearly with the collection.
suggestion: Fetch or mutate the required records in one batch outside the loop.
limitations: Only direct execute, query, scalar, scalars, and get calls on database-shaped receivers such as cursor, connection, session, engine, database, or repository variables are reported.
Unqualified calls and methods on receivers without database-oriented names are excluded; calls hidden behind application helpers are not inferred.
